title: Mock 2 · Markets & Products
blurb: Instruments and intermediaries: bonds, derivatives, CIVs and how the PMS product fits among them, with a sweep of the PMS rulebook.

questions.q: An investor with a real risk-free rate of 3% expects inflation of 5%. Using the exact formula, the nominal risk-free rate of return is approximately:
hints: Wrong: simple addition ignores the cross term.
Correct: exact multiplicative formula.
Wrong: this is the difference.
Wrong: multiplies the rates directly.

questions.q: Which type of risk is illustrated by penny stocks that are difficult to sell in significant quantities at the desired price?
questions.explanation: Liquidity risk is the difficulty of buying or selling without significantly affecting price; penny stocks and bonds of lesser-known issuers are the workbook's examples.
hints: Wrong: political risk stems from government action.
Wrong: exchange rate risk arises from currency moves.
Correct: lack of buyers at desired price.
Wrong: regulatory risk arises from changes in law.

questions.q: The clearing corporation acting as buyer to every seller and seller to every buyer is known as:
questions.explanation: Clearing corporations provide full novation of contracts, which substantially reduces operational risk for investors.
hints: Correct: novation.
Wrong: dematerialisation converts physical to electronic holdings.
Wrong: netting computes net obligations; it is not substitution of counterparty.
Wrong: rematerialisation converts electronic back to physical.

questions.q: A company is expected to pay a dividend of ₹6 next year. The required return is 14% and dividends are expected to grow at 10% forever. Using the Gordon Growth Model, the intrinsic value is:
hints: Wrong: divides by r only.
Wrong: divides by g only.
Wrong: divides by r + g.
Correct: 6 / 0.04.

questions.q: Which valuation multiple is widely used for banks and financial services companies, whose assets closely follow market value?
questions.explanation: The P/B ratio is widely used for financial services and banking stocks where assets closely follow their market value.
hints: Wrong: P/S suits loss-making or low-margin firms.
Wrong: EV/EBITDA suits capital-intensive firms.
Correct: P/BV.
Wrong: PEG adjusts P/E for growth.

questions.q: Technical analysts primarily study:
questions.explanation: Technical analysis forecasts price direction by studying patterns in historical market data, i.e., price and volume.
hints: Correct: price and volume patterns.
Wrong: this is fundamental analysis.
Wrong: economic analysis is part of EIC.
Wrong: qualitative company analysis is fundamental.

questions.q: A bond whose market price is below its face value (trading at a discount) will have a YTM that is:
questions.explanation: When the price is less than face value, YTM > coupon; at a premium YTM < coupon; at par they are equal.
hints: Wrong: equality holds only at par.
Wrong: that is for a premium bond.
Wrong: YTM is not zero.
Correct: discount bond YTM exceeds coupon.

questions.q: Which pair of derivatives is traded over the counter (OTC)?
options: Currency futures and interest rate futures
questions.explanation: Forwards and swaps are OTC derivatives; futures and options are exchange-traded.
hints: Wrong: these are exchange-traded.
Correct: forwards and swaps are OTC.
Wrong: both exchange-traded in India.
Wrong: both listed on exchanges.

questions.q: Which entity is found in the structure of an InvIT but not listed for a mutual fund in the workbook?
questions.explanation: The InvIT structure includes a Project Manager responsible for operating and maintaining infrastructure projects.
hints: Wrong: MFs also have a sponsor.
Wrong: MFs also have a trustee.
Correct: the Project Manager is unique to InvITs.
Wrong: MFs also have a custodian.

questions.q: SEBI first issued regulations for portfolio managers in:
questions.explanation: January 1993 marked the beginning of PMS when SEBI issued the Portfolio Managers Regulations, 1993, even before the mutual fund regulations.
hints: Correct: January 1993.
Wrong: not the date in the workbook.
Wrong: July 2005 is when PMLA came into force.
Wrong: the current regulations are of 2020, but the first were in 1993.

questions.q: Client funds held by a portfolio manager must be kept in a separate account maintained in:
options: The portfolio manager's own current account
A cooperative bank of the client's choice
questions.explanation: The PM shall keep the funds of all clients in a separate account maintained by it in a Scheduled Commercial Bank.
hints: Wrong: client funds must be separate from the PM's own funds.
Wrong: the regulation specifies a Scheduled Commercial Bank.
Correct: Scheduled Commercial Bank.
Wrong: NBFCs are not specified.

questions.q: Which portfolio manager is NOT required to appoint a custodian?
options: A PM offering both discretionary and advisory services
A portfolio manager providing only advisory services
questions.explanation: Except for a PM providing only advisory services (and co-investment PMs), every PM must appoint a custodian.
hints: Wrong: discretionary PMs must appoint one.
Wrong: non-discretionary PMs must appoint one.
Wrong: offering discretionary services triggers the requirement.
Correct: advisory-only PMs are exempt.

questions.q: As per the workbook, which group of entities can invest in PMS, subject to the ₹50 lakh minimum?
options: Individuals, NRIs, HUFs, proprietorship and partnership firms, AOPs, LLPs, trusts and body corporates
questions.explanation: Section 8.1 lists individuals, NRIs (per RBI guidelines), HUFs, proprietorship firms, AOPs, partnership firms, LLPs, trusts and body corporates.
hints: Wrong: NRIs and non-individuals are also eligible.
Wrong: individuals are eligible too.
Correct: the full workbook list.
Wrong: accredited investors are only exempt from the minimum; others can invest too.

questions.q: Which statement about direct on-boarding in PMS is correct?
options: Direct on-boarding is optional for portfolio managers to offer
Only statutory charges can be levied when a client is on-boarded directly
Direct clients pay a higher fee
Direct on-boarding is allowed only for accredited investors
questions.explanation: PMs shall provide an option for direct on-boarding without distributors, prominently disclose it, and levy no charges except statutory charges.
hints: Wrong: PMs shall provide the option.
Correct: only statutory charges.
Wrong: no extra charges apply.
Wrong: available to all clients.

questions.q: Under a High Water Mark structure, a portfolio starts at ₹1 crore, rises to ₹1.2 crore in Year 1, falls to ₹1 crore in Year 2 and rises to ₹1.3 crore in Year 3. In Year 3 the performance fee is charged on gains above:
questions.explanation: Performance fee is charged only on gains above the previous highest value (₹1.2 crore), so on ₹10 lakh in Year 3.
hints: Wrong: that would charge again for gains already rewarded.
Wrong: that is the current value.
Wrong: no such level in the example.
Correct: the previous peak of ₹1.2 crore.

questions.q: According to the workbook, the long-run performance of investment portfolios depends majorly on:
questions.explanation: Professional experience suggests that in the long run portfolio performance depends majorly on asset allocation.
hints: Correct: asset allocation.
Wrong: costs matter but are not the main driver.
Wrong: not the primary driver.
Wrong: reporting does not drive returns.

questions.q: An investor's preference to avoid companies selling environmentally harmful products is treated in the IPS as:
questions.explanation: Personal, social, ethical or cultural preferences that restrict investments are unique needs and preferences, to be specified in the IPS.
hints: Wrong: liquidity is about access to cash.
Wrong: tax constraints relate to taxation.
Correct: unique needs and preferences.
Wrong: no regulation imposes this.

questions.q: The emergency cash reserve suggested in the workbook is usually:
questions.explanation: Emergency cash is usually measured as two to three months' spending, more if income is at risk or volatile.
hints: Wrong: too little.
Correct: two to three months.
Wrong: not the workbook's measure.
Wrong: not how it is measured.

questions.q: Which factor in factor-based investing refers to securities with strong past performance continuing their upward trend in the short term?
questions.explanation: Momentum: securities with strong past performance tend to continue their upward trend in the short term.
hints: Wrong: value targets undervalued stocks.
Wrong: quality targets strong profitability and low debt.
Wrong: size refers to smaller companies outperforming.
Correct: momentum.

questions.q: A portfolio holds 60% in stock A (beta 1.4) and 40% in stock B (beta 0.9). The portfolio beta is:
hints: Wrong: simple average of the betas.
Correct: weighted average.
Wrong: arithmetic slip.
Wrong: sum of the betas.

questions.q: Which return measure neutralises the effect of investor deposits and withdrawals and is therefore ideal for comparing portfolio managers?
questions.explanation: TWRR breaks the period at external cash flows and links sub-period returns, eliminating the effect of investor cash flows.
hints: Correct: TWRR.
Wrong: XIRR is affected by the timing of cash flows.
Wrong: HPR ignores timing of flows.
Wrong: gross return is before fees, not about cash flows.

questions.q: Income from futures and options transactions in a PMS is taxed as:
questions.explanation: F&O income in PMS is classified as business income under PGBP and taxed at slab rates.
hints: Wrong: not capital gains.
Wrong: not capital gains.
Wrong: it is taxable.
Correct: business income.

questions.q: Long-term capital gains on debt investments (held more than 24 months) are taxed at:
questions.explanation: LTCG on debt is taxed at 12.5% under Section 112; the indexation benefit was removed since July 2024.
hints: Wrong: indexation has been removed.
Wrong: outdated rate and benefit.
Correct: 12.5% without indexation.
Wrong: slab rate applies to STCG on debt.

questions.q: The SEBI (Prohibition of Fraudulent and Unfair Trade Practices relating to Securities Market) Regulations were issued in:
questions.explanation: The PFUTP Regulations are of 2003; PIT Regulations are 2015, PMLA is 2002 and PM Regulations are 2020.
hints: Correct: 2003.
Wrong: 2015 is the insider trading regulations.
Wrong: 2002 is PMLA.
Wrong: 2020 is the Portfolio Managers Regulations.

questions.q: With which body must every person or entity distributing portfolio management services obtain registration?
questions.explanation: Per SEBI circular of May 02, 2024, any person or entity involved in PMS distribution shall obtain registration with APMI.
hints: Wrong: AMFI is for mutual fund distributors.
Correct: APMI.
Wrong: FIU-IND receives STRs.
Wrong: RBI does not register PMS distributors.
